name: Corrected Public Core Boundary Readiness Audit

previousAudit.falseNegativeReason: The previous readiness heuristic looked for `ReverseTranslationResult` and `ReverseFailure`, but the implemented/frozen Core contract uses `ReverseTranslationOutcome` and `ReverseTranslationFailure`.

exactPublicCoreSurfaceCandidate.rootIndexStrategy: Use explicit named exports from reverse-translator.js and explicit type exports from reverse-translation.js. Do not use export * for the new reverse boundary.
exactPublicCoreSurfaceCandidate.packageExportsReason: @persian-braille/core already exposes only the package root through dist/index.js/dist/index.d.ts; the reverse API should be added to that root surface without adding a new subpath.

recommendedNext: If decision is READY_FOR_PUBLIC_CORE_BOUNDARY_FREEZE, materialize a narrow Phase 13.5c-3c2 boundary freeze: document the exact Core root reverse exports above, then expose only those symbols from packages/core/src/index.ts, add root-boundary tests/validator, run the full Phase 13 chain, and keep the SDK reverse API deferred to its separate step.
